Twin Securities Inc decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) (NXPI) by 33.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Twin Securities Inc sold 104,700 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.13% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 206,100 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $24.13 million, down from 310,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Twin Securities Inc who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $34.02 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $98.91. About 638,635 shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since May 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
First Manhattan Company increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Manhattan Company bought 26,437 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 3.43M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $579.94 million, up from 3.40 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Manhattan Company who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $927.44B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.33% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $188.69. About 9.87M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
